message:
Revert "fix buffer overflow (#30)"

This reverts commit 94df772485c92866ca417d92137747b2e3b0a917.
target_issue: Removes the end-of-input checks in parse_string's escape handling, so a string ending in a backslash reads past the buffer (buffer over-read, CVE-2016-10749).

source.dataset: SEVRA-style pair (fix from the GitHub advisory)

notes: Reversal of the fix, honestly labeled as a revert (constructed, not a SEVRA record).
